book.name: 2 Kolinita
book.title: 2 KOLINITA MeKolinita ꞌidi leta heluwena Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Cehele ꞌawawa weyahina
Ciyagwao, nuwanuwama ma tohekalesiyao Masidoniya ꞌalona wasanapudi ꞌabehega Yehoba ꞌiꞌabihetediya ꞌihenuwa laguwediya ta ꞌehele ꞌawawa ꞌausalana silaguya.
Taudi towewelohe gide tuwa ꞌebetohona silobeya ꞌidi miya ꞌana mwau ꞌoinega, ma hesi tuwa maꞌidi yaliyaya helau bwebweꞌana hedade silaguya.
Yagwaeya moisa, meMasidoniyaedi ꞌatedi sitagwalediya ta ꞌidi ginaulao siꞌehele ꞌawawediya maꞌana loheposeyana.
Ma siꞌahwaꞌahwanoi waiwai ꞌoima ma ꞌeguma sowasowahina sihelau Yelusalema ꞌana tohekalesiyao ꞌadi sagu weyahina.
Tauma ꞌima nuwatuhu ma sihelau, maꞌiyamo ꞌidi ꞌehele madou hedade, weyahina Bada ꞌoina sitagwala nugetediya, ꞌoinega wete sitagwalediya tauma ꞌoima, gide Yehoba ꞌina nuwatuhu.
Coinega Taito ꞌahegwaeya, ꞌagwaeya, “Mwalo ꞌuhegaina ma meKolinita ꞌuꞌabihetediya ꞌidi ꞌehele ꞌana paihowa weyahina, ꞌoinega ꞌuꞌabihetedi wete ma silosalohi.”
Comi wamumuga ꞌausala pwaiya ꞌimi paihowa baibaiwana ꞌoidiyega, beno hemisa ma hepwaila ma sanapu ma hepwatu ma wete ꞌimi helau ꞌoima, ꞌoinega sowasowahimi ma ꞌehele ꞌausalana wete wapaihowa.

Bewa ꞌigu gwae tuwa ma geya ꞌabehega yaloinegomi, ma yanuwatuhuya tohekalesiyao tupwana sihehetapewa ꞌehele ꞌawawa weyahina, ꞌoinega ꞌebetohona bewa yalaguya ma taꞌita nuwana waꞌehele bwaibwaina, bo geya.
Comi ꞌida Bada Yesu Keliso ꞌina helau wasanapuya, tauna ꞌina wasawasa madouna ꞌiꞌebesineya ma ꞌiheweweloheya sabi ꞌabihetegomi, ta ꞌabehega ꞌina hewewelohe ꞌoinega ꞌomi wahewasawasa.
Coinega nuwatuhu yaꞌebwaegomi. Bolime ꞌigumwala nuwanuwami ma wahelau, ꞌoinega wahelau nugeta, ta hali boda mulimiya.
Coinega sowasowahina ma walosalohi. Mwalo wahetapewa ta wahegaineya, ꞌoinega nata wete ꞌimi ꞌatetagwalega toꞌaha ꞌoimiya simiyamiya ꞌoidiyega helauina walosalohi.
Sahena wagwaegwae ma wagwae, “Geya ꞌeta ginaula ꞌoima ma ꞌoinega ꞌahelau.” Hesi tuwa wahetapewa ma toꞌaha ꞌoimiya ꞌimiyamiya ꞌoidiyega wahelau, ma Yehoba waꞌabihe yaliyaya.
Bewa geya ꞌabehega ꞌomi ꞌimi helau ꞌana mwau madouna ma hali ꞌasa ꞌidi helau ꞌana mwau muhemuhena, ma hesiyage mahemahetena tuwa.

Ceguma bewa tuwa ꞌimi tobwatobwa baibaiwana, sowasowahina ma hali ꞌasa waꞌabihetedi ꞌidi miyamwau ꞌoidiyega, ma ꞌeguma to tuta taudi ꞌidi tobwatobwa baibaiwana siꞌabihetegomi wete, ꞌeguma wamiya mwau. Coinega wada hemahemahetena.
Gidemusa gwae ꞌimiyamiya Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Taudi siheꞌauta madouna ꞌadi ꞌeꞌahai geya ꞌana tupwamo, ma taudi siheꞌauta ꞌiꞌiuna ꞌadi ꞌeꞌahai tuwa sowasowahidi, eeta sihemahemahetena.”

content: Taito maꞌiyanao sitautauya Kolinita
Yehoba ꞌoina yaloyauwedo, weyahina Taito ꞌina nuwatuhu madouna ꞌiꞌebwae pwaiya, ma tauna ꞌiꞌabihetegomi, gide tauma wete ꞌima nuwatuhu.
Coinega tutaina ꞌahegwaeya ma ꞌihaboꞌenegomi ꞌitagwala bwaibwaineya, weyahina beno tauna ꞌina nuwatuhu madouna.
Coinega wete tasidai ꞌaigeda Taito baꞌidana ꞌahetunediwa, tauna tologuguya ꞌaigeda wasa bwebweꞌana weyahina, ma sanina madouna tohekalesiyao ꞌoidiya,
ma tohekalesiyao ꞌina paihowa siꞌebwaeya ta tauna baꞌidamai ꞌasakosakowasi ꞌehele weyahina sabi ꞌabihetegomi, ma ꞌoinega tomota Yehoba sihepwatuwe.
Geya nuwama ma ꞌeta taiya ꞌilomugiyemai ꞌigwae, “Helau ꞌawawaina madouna ma geya sida ꞌitayahi bwaibwainiya.”
Ma hesi nuwanuwama tuta baibaiwana ꞌoidiya ꞌada paihowa dumwalu Yehoba matana, ma wete tomota matadiya.

Tasidai wete ꞌaigeda baꞌidadiu ꞌahesumaneyawa, tauna ꞌasanapuya ꞌabehega tohemisa moisa ꞌina paihowa baibaiwana ꞌoidiyega, ma bewa tuwa ꞌomi ꞌimi mumuga bwebweꞌana ꞌihesagoha pwaiya ta ꞌihemiseya, ꞌoinega nuwanuwana madouna ꞌihaboꞌenegomi sabi ꞌabihetegomi wete.
Taito wasanapuya ꞌabehega baꞌidagu ꞌapaihowa mahemahetena ꞌami lema weyahina, ma tasidaowedi taudi tohekalesiyao weyahidi sipaipaihowa, ta weyahina tomota Keliso sihepwatuweya.
Coinega ꞌilobwainegomiya ma tasidaowedi wahelau bwaibwainidi, ma boda hekalesiya baibaiwadi siꞌahwa moisaegomi, ma wete siꞌahwa moisaemai ꞌima hepwatu ꞌimi helauina weyahina.
